verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with a public API, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no documented OpenAPI or equivalent spec: the probe got 404s on every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path. The llms.txt file and the CLI are adjacent features, not API specs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
